# About this edition {.unnumbered}

This is the technical manual for skyscapeR **2.0.9004**. It documents how the package calculates its results, which assumptions affect their interpretation and which comparisons have been made against independent observations. Each study names the build tested.

For a first analysis, follow the [worked vignette](https://stonexsky.github.io/skyscapeR/). The [package README](https://github.com/stonexsky/skyscapeR/blob/development-2.0/README.md) covers installation and migration to version 2.0.

## Finding a method

Use the [function index](function-index.qmd) to find a help page or an implementation note by name. The [methods guide](contents-plan.qmd) groups the calculations by research question. The [vignette guide](vignette-guide.qmd) connects each step in the worked analysis to its technical explanation.

## Finding the evidence

For terrain horizons, [H01](study-register.qmd#h01-field-validation) measures field accuracy and [H02](study-register.qmd#h02-skyline-comparison) compares numerical skylines at matched viewpoints. For sky reconstruction, consult the [Milky Way tracing and calibration](sky-rendering.qmd#milky-way-boundary-internal-structure-and-calibration) and the [sky-rendering studies](study-register.qmd#sky-rendering). The [heliacal-rising study](heliacal-rising.qmd) evaluates event timing. The [ephemeris chapter](ephemeris.qmd) distinguishes upstream precision claims from independent tests of this package.
